prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1395; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injury observed on examination, and the findings are in keeping with the force described. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the right shoulder. The patient completed eight visits over the course of care, consisting of manual therapy, guided home exercise, and range-of-motion work. Treatment followed a typical course, with the frequency of visits tapering as strength and mobility improved and pain decreased. A remote, minor strain involving the same region was noted in the history; it had resolved completely without lasting limitation and does not appear to account for the current presentation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no repeated charges. At discharge the patient was improving and was advised to continue the home program as needed.
